title: Pause and park
summary: Mode parked or turn posture waiting declares intentional pause. A paused work-claim holder remains parked as activity ages; silence alone never declares pause. Before parking on another item, record the merge or delivery wait through items.dependency.add; a dependency_cycle refusal must be resolved before parking. The held item’s own release wait needs no self-edge. The Sessions page Active filter excludes sessions with native_process_gone_at set. Parked sessions remain visible under Parked with their held claims; process-gone parked workers use no machine lane until resumed.
